title: An aisle seat on the right night
task: D1 18:30. I am Eli, at tonight’s concert. Can you help me swap into a seat next to my friend F at B8-02? It must be the same price tier. Lights go down at 19:20. Please check both tickets privately and register an exchange only when both people have freely agreed to the exact seats.
